recorded.prompt:q-refund-through-double: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-refund-through-double: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-refund-through-double: 11.1 decides b: it shows '0.29 USD through a double  4=000000000028' and says '0.29 * 100 is 28.999999999999996, and the cast keeps 28', so 434.99999999999994 becomes 434.
recorded.prompt:q-sized-by-average: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sized-by-average: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sized-by-average: 11.3's arithmetic gives 80/s and 40 in flight against 10 sessions, and 11.4 shows that when the pool is short, requests queue for longer every second until answers come too late.
recorded.prompt:q-dashboard: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dashboard: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dashboard: 11.3: a 99th percentile past the terminal's timeout means at least 1% end with no answer and are reversed, as in 'At 150 a second, 1.5% is over two reversals a second'.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-pool: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-pool: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-pool: 11.4's one-pool case shows healthy issuers' requests queueing behind a slow issuer's and answering too late; here Q alone needs 200 of 120 sessions.
recorded.prompt:q-refusal-code: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-refusal-code: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-refusal-code: 11.4: 'A decline says the issuer refused the card', so an 05 tells the acquirer and the cardholder the card was refused.

recorded.prompt:q-refund-through-double:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-refund-through-double:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-refund-through-double:a: 11.1 refutes rounding: 28.999999999999996 became 28, not 29, so the cast truncates.
recorded.prompt:q-refund-through-double:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-refund-through-double:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-refund-through-double:c: 11.1's double line yields a value (4=000000000028) with no error; only toISO87String refuses an amount, not the cast.
recorded.prompt:q-refund-through-double:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-refund-through-double:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-refund-through-double:d: 11.1 and its Reference say field 4 is 12 digits of minor units and GBP has 2 decimals, and the 0.29 USD example converts a two-decimal amount into field 4 without refusal.
recorded.prompt:q-sized-by-average:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sized-by-average:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sized-by-average:b: 11.4's one-pool run shows that when the session-seconds of work exceed the sessions, the queue grows every second and answers come too late.
recorded.prompt:q-sized-by-average:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sized-by-average:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sized-by-average:c: 11.3 opens with 'The year's average says nothing about the rate the switch must carry'.
recorded.prompt:q-sized-by-average:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sized-by-average:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-sized-by-average:d: 11.3 says to multiply the busiest hour's average by the burst factor, which gives 40 in flight, not 10.
recorded.prompt:q-dashboard:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dashboard:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dashboard:b: 11.3 says the unanswered purchase is reversed and that 'Sending it again would risk a second charge'.
recorded.prompt:q-dashboard:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dashboard:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dashboard:c: 11.3: 'By its mean the switch is quick. The 99th percentile is 31 seconds, and terminals give up at 30'.
recorded.prompt:q-dashboard:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-dashboard:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-dashboard:d: 11.3's sample has a median of 0.3 s and still 15 of 1000 answers after 30 s.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-pool:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-pool:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-pool:b: 11.4's one-pool run shows '91 at once 0' for every issuer; an immediate 91 appears only with a limit.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-pool:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-pool:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-pool:c: 11.4: 'A and B are healthy, their cardholders see timeouts'.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-pool:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-pool:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-pool:d: 11.4: with one pool, A's and B's requests queue behind C's.
recorded.prompt:q-refusal-code:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-refusal-code:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-refusal-code:b: 11.4 gives 'issuer or switch inoperative' to 91 and 'the issuer refused the card' to a decline such as 05.

recorded.outcome:q-refusal-code:c: 11.4 contrasts a decline, the issuer's decision about the card, with 91, an error after which the cardholder may try again.
